contests.title: Governor and Lieutenant Governor
contests.scopeNote: Governor and Lieutenant Governor are printed together as one ticket; vote for one.

coverageNotes: Please note: The sample ballots will be listed on a rolling basis as they become available. Updated 10/6/2026

Candidate coverage comes from 57 official town sample-ballot PDFs, covering 218 ballot pages. A statewide certified candidate roster was not acquired; all candidate-list completeness flags remain false.
The sample ballots cover all 5 U.S. House districts, 30 of 36 state Senate districts, and 79 of 151 state House districts.
State Senate districts not covered by the acquired town samples: 1, 3, 10, 15, 25, 27.

The official Questions on the Ballot page contains 2018 materials and no 2026 statewide measure list. Statewide measure coverage remains unresolved; this does not establish that no measures are on the ballot.
The ballots do not state candidate incumbency or campaign websites; these fields are unknown.
Fusion nominations remain separate party lines. The joint Governor and Lieutenant Governor ticket is retained as printed in one candidacy per party line.
